blocks.html: Alan Klikic is a Senior Solution Architect at Lightbend. He has 15+ years of experience in software development and is passionate about reactive and distributed systems. Prior to Lightbend, Alan was a co-owner and technical lead of Intenda Net, Croatian software company developing in-house software solutions using Lightbend products. Alan holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Zagreb, Croatia and currently resides in the Netherlands with his wife and four children.
